classification_rules.value_weak: some Q healthy and V RMSE>1.15*best-Q RMSE

fairness.variable_cardinality: all set critics use masks and max_agents=12; collected 4v1 is not hard-coded in model

limits: Action ranking is twin stability over AW9 counterfactual queries, not counterfactual ground truth.
Success/collision ordering compares successful normal-capture transition rows with actual collision transition rows.
MC return is a realized policy return and retains aleatoric outcome variance.
A1 is representation identifiability only; no algorithm ranking or policy improvement was run.

sampling.method: inverse-primary-event-frequency capped; same schedule per seed across critics
